title: Shiraishi An — Peak Excitement!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's so nice out!
A perfect day to practice!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki!
What's up? Out and about today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup♪ I just went and checked out this apparel shop that just opened.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, does this bag mean you got something there? I love this design!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me too! Everything this place had was so in right now and really adorable.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Mind if I take a peek at what you got?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sure, check this out♪ The one with the plastic cover has these gorgeous lace and frill patterns on it. You can really tell the designer put their heart and soul into it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. You must really love it!
It'd be great to see how you look in it, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's been a while since I last found a place like this, so I'd love to show you sometime, An.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I even found one in a different color with this really chic design! I bet it'd look great on someone with straight hair like you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't really know much about these kinds of clothes, but if you're willing to go that far...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I really mean it!
Lemme show this place to you sometime!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, but I actually just spent a bunch of money on some new clothes recently...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I ended up splurging a bit to make sure I had something good to wear, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way, how'd it go?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was the best day ever!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's great.
Tell me more! Where'd you guys go and stuff?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'd love to stay and talk, but I have to go practice with Kohane and the others soon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure thing! Oh, I know. How about I tell you all about it during lunch the next time you come to school?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
All during lunch?
Haha. You must be dying to tell me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll be back soon! I really want to hear more about you too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wow, it's already been a week since that day too...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Look! The center of the fountain under Phenny's feet! It's like there's something there, but not. Can you see it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
Was there a Phenny hiding there this whole time?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we make this our hidden Phenny?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it'll be our special spot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The way she smiled was so priceless.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I want to be by her side and keep seeing that smile...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I hope I can keep being her partner too.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I have to keep trying my best to stay her partner. No, probably even harder than ever...!)
